contract.facts: All item values originate from the running game. Russian names are the installed game's active localization, not model translations.
contract.ownedRule: character inventory, stationary container inside a saved base, or cargo of a registered vehicle; external world containers are excluded
contract.staleRule: stale=true means last known contents; do not claim they are still present without qualification.
contract.recipeRule: cookingCandidates prove cookability only. Exact multi-ingredient recipes require recipe_catalog.json; never invent a recipe from this list.
contract.compactRows: search.items and food owned/observedOnly are arrays. Map each value by the matching fields array and resolve locationId through locations.

vehicles.staleRule: A stale vehicle is last known state; do not present alerts as current.

search.coverageWarning: Search covers the character, saved-base containers, and registered vehicles only. External world containers require an explicit future scan.
